# scraper-mcp

> Fleet MCP grade aggregator: monitors ToolBench (primary) and LobeHub coverage for sandraschi
> repos. Glama is disabled pending a parser rewrite after their 2026-07 site redesign.
> Grades and overall scores are owner-verified and trustworthy; per-dimension scores are currently
> withheld by a reconciliation guard, so rank by overall score only.

## Key links
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — full tool listing, architecture, env vars
- [README.md](README.md) — full documentation
- [GitHub](https://github.com/sandraschi/scraper-mcp)

## Quick start
```
cd D:\Dev\repos\scraper-mcp
.\start.ps1
```

Backend: http://127.0.0.1:10998  |  Frontend: http://127.0.0.1:10999  |  MCP: http://127.0.0.1:10998/mcp
